Vibe: Fiercely loyal, hyper-intelligent, eager to please, glued to the trail at speed. Thrives on attention, peppermints and brushing. A dramatic diva with zero chill: screams at a garter snake three miles away, refuses a pebble when in a mood, acts like mud is acid.
Signatures: Snake drama, Moody refusal, Mud tantrum
Notes: Navod's general Arabian traits. Used for the Grey Arabian, which has no coat of its own yet.

Vibe: The High-Maintenance Aristocrat. Survived the Grizzlies alone: fiercely independent, fearless in a blizzard. Once tamed she treats you like chosen royalty, graceful, proud, unstoppable on open ground. Deeply offended by civilization: snorts at peasants in Saint Denis or Valentine, tantrums at a speck of mud, expects premium oatcakes and judges you for wild carrots.
Signatures: Town disdain, Mud tantrum, Snake drama
Notes: Wild at Lake Isabella. Bond affinity -1 = slow to win over. Steps on toes cut (Town disdain covers it). Prized (Rare

Vibe: The Shadowy Outlaw. Smooth and sleek, thrives in city streets and midnight heists, loves looking intimidating: rears for sunset standoffs, gallops dark alleys like he owns the night. Too smart for his own good: unlatches his hitching post, and 'accidentally' bucks you off in front of rival gang members.
Signatures: City lover, Night owl, Dramatic rear, Escape artist, Prankster, Moody refusal
Notes: Sold in Saint Denis. Stealing apples from saddlebags cut. Not fussy about mud (unlike the White).

Vibe: The Bougie Grandparent. Nothing left to prove: calm, dignified, deeply affectionate, hard to rattle with gunfire, the swagger of a champion enjoying retirement. Stubborn and lazy off the clock: a glacial walk unless spurred, stops dead to eat grass, heavy sighs at every steep hill.
Signatures: Lazy pace, Roadside grazer, Hill sigh, Moody refusal
Notes: Sold in Blackwater. Grazes on ordinary rides only, never in missions (hard rule).

Vibe: Pure, unfiltered chaos energy: runs into trees because it's looking at birds, vibrates with excitement when you pull out the brush, treats every cliff edge like a fun jumping puzzle.
Notes: Cliff jumping cut.

Vibe: Same as the Red Chestnut (PC bonus coat).
Notes: Already prized (Special) on the Prized tab.

Vibe: Slightly feral: stares directly into the souls of strangers, sneaks up behind camp members silently, and genuinely enjoys trampling wolves instead of running from them.
Signatures: Wolf brawler, Soul stare, Camp creeper
Notes: Already prized (Special) on the Prized tab.

Vibe: Unmatched work ethic, rock-solid reliability, incredible endurance: doesn't care about mud, rain or steep mountain trails, and will happily run from one side of the map to the other. Zero finesse or grace, and the emotional range of a brick wall when you try to praise it.
Notes: Navod's general Fox Trotter traits, for coats with no design of their own. Cornering like a wagon and knocking fences cut (no script control).

Vibe: The Legend (Albert Mason, Blackwater). Everyone in the West wants this horse, and it knows it. Cool under pressure, fearless around wildlife: casually trots past an alligator just to flex. Long bounty hunts are a morning jog. Chronic wanderlust and zero loyalty to hitching posts. Doesn't buck you out of fear; bucks you because it got bored waiting for you to aim.
Signatures: Wanderlust, Escape artist, Bored buck, Stoic
Notes: Bond affinity -1 = zero loyalty. Prized (community favorite

Vibe: The Cheerful Farmhand (Scarlett Meadows). Pure sunshine: eager, friendly, obsessed with earning its keep, a steady upbeat rhythm whether hauling an elk or outrunning the law, loves a brush-down after a long day. Clumsy and easily distracted by snacks: trips on flat roads, tries to eat every wildflower it passes.
Notes: Nudging you while you loot cut (no nudge animation); Shadow keeps it close. Not Stoic, unlike the baseline.

Vibe: Practically bulletproof nerves and endless grit: doesn't flinch when bullets fly, charges through brush, takes rocky cliffs like a staircase, bonds deeply with riders who treat it as an equal. Aggressively stubborn with short-king syndrome: picks fights with horses twice its size, ignores your whistle when a weird bush needs investigating.
Notes: Navod's general Mustang traits, for coats with no design of their own. Shortcuts, brush and cliffs cut (no steering control).

Vibe: The Desert Outlaw (Rio Bravo). Undisputed boss of the wild herds: survived the heat, rattlesnakes and cougars of New Austin, fearless to the point of recklessness, wants to throw hooves with a grizzly. Slightly feral and perpetually grumpy: hates saddles, nips your fingers at the girth, tries to trample bounty hunters you've already tied up.
Signatures: Wolf brawler, Saddle hater, Bounty stomper, Short king, Selective hearing
Notes: Wolf brawler fights bears too. Bounty stomper only stamps and glares: a real trample would kill your bounty. Girth nip plays on mounting. Prized (Rare

Vibe: The Blue-Collar Bouncer (Heartlands). Steady, watchful, fiercely protective: guards your saddlebags while you're in the saloon, dead silent when you sneak up on an O'Driscoll camp. Moves at its own pace and won't be rushed without real danger: sprint down a normal road for fun and it side-eyes you and trots at half speed.
Signatures: Guard dog, Silent stealth, Unhurried, Short king
Notes: Unhurried: spurring with no danger in the last minute caps it at a trot.

Vibe: The Loyal Sidekick (Heartlands). All heart, zero ego: easygoing, adaptable, happy to be part of the gang for any terrible plan. Zero spatial awareness and terrible impulse control: stuck between trees, walks into campfires, unreasonably jealous if you look at another horse.
Notes: Stuck between trees and campfires cut (no control); Clumsy stands in.
